references.inspection: Individually inspected full terrace photograph: central pediment and circular window, three upper openings with low iron guards, pale pilaster strips, loggia, mint shutters and stone terrace.
references.use: Geometry reference only; no photo pixels embedded.

sources.title: Liebermann Villa: Villa and Garden
sources.facts: Museum identifies two large shell-limestone columns on the street facade and a pedimented central projection toward the lake. Lake garden is terraced.

notes: All eighteen local reference candidates browsed in two contact sheets; historical painting, plaques, sculpture and interior murals are not used as current exterior geometry.

previousTerrarium.method: Unmodified Terrarium pixels bilinearly sampled at pixel centers in the signed local model frame. Heights are not flattened or fitted to the building.

terrainComparison.replacement: Berlin ATKIS DGM1 bare-earth elevation; exact download URLs and ZIP hashes retained in terrain-grid.json. Finer terrain resolves the ground around the villa and its raised terrace. DGM1 is sampled unchanged.
terrainComparison.horizontalConversion: pyproj Transformer EPSG:4326 to EPSG:25833, always_xy; source XYZ cells at half-meter centers.
